gloss: firing a gun; discharge of a firearm

definitions.explanation: Discharging a firearm, especially in police, crime and war reports; する makes it a verb, with the target marked by に.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警官|けいかん}→警官：02876_keikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発砲|はっぽう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A police officer fired his gun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{発砲|はっぽう}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: There was a shooting incident in town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧{数発|すうはつ}{発砲|はっぽう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧あと、⟦{逃走|とうそう}→逃走：14403_tousou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The suspect fired several shots at the car and then fled.

notes:
A news word. The target or direction is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発砲|はっぽう}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: a shooting incident
- ⟦{威嚇|いかく}→威嚇：09164_ikaku⟧{発砲|はっぽう}: a warning shot
- ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧{発砲|はっぽう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fire into the air
- {発砲|はっぽう}{音|おん}: the sound of gunfire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{銃撃|じゅうげき}→銃撃：27092_juugeki⟧: shooting at someone; an armed attack
- ⟦{発泡|はっぽう}→発泡：31178_happou⟧: foaming (same reading; ⟦{発泡|はっぽう}→発泡：31178_happou⟧スチロール is Styrofoam)
